title: Orb flies figure-eights over the Capitol for 45 minutes during a skywatch after the hearing

tellings.quote: and Anna Luna, right? And afterwards we went out and did a skywatch on the the um Library Congress, right? We were up on the platform and suddenly this orb appears and for 45 minutes it did figure8s over the cap in the white house.

plain: In 2025, after a congressional hearing on unexplained flying objects, a glowing orb appeared and flew figure-eights over the Capitol and the White House for 45 minutes, as a group watched from a platform at the Library of Congress. Chris Bledsoe, a North Carolina man who says he attracts UFOs, tells Jesse Michels he was there, naming Congresswoman Anna Paulina Luna and Congressman Eric Burlison among those around the hearing. He offers it as a sighting over the seat of government itself.
